outcome: Maternal and child healthcare use (pregnancy follow-up visits)
Share of difficulties in delivering health-care services in stillbirths and infant deaths
Rate of families without health insurance in stillbirths and infant deaths
Rate of unemployed persons contributing to family budget in stillbirths and infant deaths
cohort: The study analyzed 293 stillbirths and 324 infant deaths that occurred in Samsun Province of Turkey between March 1, 2018, and March 1, 2021.
finding: Compared to pre-pandemic periods, the COVID-19 pandemic period showed a similar number of stillbirths but a significant decrease in infant mortality.
cross-section timing: Data was retrospectively analyzed for three periods: pre-pandemic 1 (March 1, 2018 - February 28, 2019), pre-pandemic 2 (March 1, 2019 - February 29, 2020), and pandemic (March 1, 2020 - February 28, 2021).
